crop_action_reference.guards: Main-interface and GPS objects plus existing RNG ranges are byte-identical around each semantic action. This does not guard every reachable heap allocation.
crop_action_reference.scope: Two unassigned PlantSeeds jobs and one FertilizeField job per case. Native clicks and semantic helper compare season values and job existence in world and farm. No attached items or workers are tested. No management/UI integration yet.

crop_job_ownership_reference.scope: Each case provisions two PlantSeeds jobs and one FertilizeField job in the paused owned session. One planting job has a citizen worker and a reserved seed. Native clicks and semantic calls compare world/farm job membership, worker current_job, item in_job and specific-reference count, seasonal selections and retention of the other job. This is controlled fixture coverage, not naturally scheduled farming completion.

transport_read_reference.scope: Actual Godot-to-bridge seasonal read path, compared to the previously native-verified semantic choice provider. No native farm sheet is opened. This does not establish rendered UI or revision-checked edits.
